text: Prompt! ... Ready! Commit! Push! ... Auto-merge! Close your laptops! Buy more GPUs. Now listen to me. Every company is going to run its own software factory. Tokens go in, software comes out, and the factory never sleeps. So you build it, you feed it, and you are going to love it.
voice_description: A Taiwanese-American man in his early sixties playing a stern drill instructor. Commanding, clipped barks at full volume with a light accent; mid-range voice with some rasp. Every command is short and explosive, with silence between. Clean close-mic studio recording, no reverb.
